records.expression: feel like going back to bed

proposed_answer.meaning_zh: 收好锋利或尖锐的工具
proposed_answer.example_en: Please put away sharp tools after using them.
proposed_answer.example_zh: 用完锋利工具后请妥善收好。
proposed_answer.usage_note: put away强调把工具收纳好；sharp tools可指刀刃锋利或尖端尖锐的工具，不能把动词短语缩减成名词。

records.expression: put dirty clothes in the hamper

proposed_answer.example_en: I hang out the laundry when the weather is dry.
proposed_answer.example_zh: 天气干燥时，我把衣物挂出去晾干。
proposed_answer.usage_note: hang out the laundry（也常说hang out the washing）表示把衣物挂出去晾晒；衣物是否已洗好由实际语境决定，非表达本身的必要语义。

proposed_answer.meaning_zh: 烤鸡肉；烤制鸡肉（本例作动词短语）
proposed_answer.example_en: We plan to roast chicken with potatoes on Sunday.
proposed_answer.example_zh: 我们计划周日用烤箱烤鸡配土豆。
proposed_answer.usage_note: 本例We plan to roast chicken中的roast为动词、chicken为宾语；单独的roast chicken亦可作名词指烤鸡菜肴。教学目标按原Sense作暂定，需Master核定POS身份。

proposed_answer.example_en: Please fill a glass with water for our guest.
proposed_answer.usage_note: fill a glass强调使杯子达到预期满度，并不等于仅往杯中倒入一点液体；通常不要求液面到杯沿。

proposed_answer.example_en: Dry the wooden board after washing.
proposed_answer.example_zh: 清洗后把那块木板晾干。
proposed_answer.usage_note: wooden board泛指木板；厨房中若特指砧板，更明确的表达是wooden cutting board。原目标是否特指砧板须由Master凭场景Sense核定。

proposed_answer.meaning_zh: 空气憋闷、不通风的房间
proposed_answer.example_en: We opened the window to air out the stuffy room.
proposed_answer.example_zh: 我们打开窗户，给那间空气不流通的房间通风。
proposed_answer.usage_note: stuffy描述空气不流通、让人感到憋闷，并不一定表示气温高；例句中的air out表示通风换气。
